title: Digi International Introduces Digi Connect IT Family of Console Access Servers for Comprehensive Management and Connectivity of IT Assets in the Data Center and Beyond
summary: Digi Connect IT products provide comprehensive and flexible remote console management at enterprise scale with plug-in, module-based connectivity and drop-through device management via Digi Remote Manager
